label: ZB 3-day daily momentum overnight (Monday longs)
researchSummary: Daily time-series momentum using a 3-day close-to-close lookback. Filter: long signals on weekday 0. Upgraded to a distinct 2:1 planned reward-to-risk variant because the time-exit entry/exit path preserves forward PF versus the legacy 1R accounting baseline.
selectionMethod: Fixed session-edge research grid; pre-2022 training ranked candidates, then post-2022 forward trades had to clear PF/trade-count/split/no-duplicate gates.
verificationSummary: Strict runner verified forward PF 2.01, 75 trades, min split PF 1.48, and no registered same-asset duplicate entries at materialization time. RR comparison accepted: baseline PF 2.01 vs 2R PF 2.01, 75 trades.
